source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Tick or circle the fail criteria from the report and check which of the results are outside of limits specified for maximum test results by the Australian and New Zealand wiring rules, AS/NZS 3760.
3. Record all of the defective tests individually.
4. Complete maximum allowed test results from the AS/NZS 3760 wiring rules.
5. If testing for appliances with medical or IT equipment, complete maximum allowed test results from the AS/NZS 3760 wiring rules and the medical/IT standards.
6. Complete the allow test results to demonstrate the defect/failure.
7. Sign off on the form.

Remember that these records are a legal proof of our work. Ensure that the information is presented with clear unambiguous language. The legal and insurance companies will use whatever your recorded result says as a legal basis for action.
